summary: Lockfile-only change (pnpm-lock.yaml). Despite the title naming only proxy-addr 2.0.7->2.0.8, the lockfile also moves hono 4.13.7->4.13.13, jose 6.2.9->6.2.12 (for @modelcontextprotocol/sdk only), express-rate-limit 8.6.2->8.7.1, ip-address 10.7.2->10.7.3, negotiator 1.0.0->1.1.0 (now depends on content-type 2.1.0, already in the lockfile), shell-quote 1.10.0->1.12.0 (optional, via gel) and acorn 8.18.0->8.19.0 (optional, via terser). All are patch/minor upgrades in the transitive tree of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (pulled in by @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk in the @cipherstash/wizard package) or optional build tooling. No package.json specifier changes. The wizard build uses skipNodeModulesBundle, so these resolutions are not bundled into the published tarball; npm consumers resolve their own versions. Effect is confined to the monorepo's install, dev, test and build environment. Impact low; the main reviewer note is that the PR scope is wider than its title.

behaviour_changes.description: proxy-addr resolution for express@5.2.1 moves from 2.0.7 to 2.0.8 (the titled change). proxy-addr computes client addresses from X-Forwarded-For trust settings in express.

Additional transitive upgrades not mentioned in the title, all within @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0's dependency tree: hono 4.13.13, jose 6.2.12, express-rate-limit 8.7.1 (with ip-address 10.7.3), negotiator 1.1.0 (via accepts 2.0.0; adds content-type 2.1.0 dependency and engines >=18).
Optional-only upgrades: shell-quote 1.12.0 (via optional gel@2.2.0) and acorn 8.19.0 (via optional terser@5.44.1); acorn 8.18.0 remains for other dependents.

failure_scenarios.title: Unannounced transitive upgrades in the agent-SDK/MCP stack break wizard dev or test runs
failure_scenarios.trigger: A behavioural change in hono, jose, express-rate-limit or negotiator between the old and new patch/minor versions that the MCP SDK relies on.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: The lockfile changes eight resolutions while the title names one, so reviewers may not examine the others. They all sit under @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0 used by the wizard's agent SDK. The only tests that exercise the real SDK are skipped unless WIZARD_INTEGRATION=1.
failure_scenarios.consequence: Wizard local/CI runs that use the agent SDK fail or behave differently. Published packages are not affected because the lockfile is not shipped and the wizard bundle excludes node_modules. Recovery is reverting the lockfile.
